reviewScope: Internal engineering/model-consistency/browser viewport review, not independent expert, official board mapping, physical-device/FPS, printer or measured corrosion validation. Chosen FeOOH-equivalent reaction4Fe+3O2+2H2O→4FeOOH; real rust is a mixture. Fixed25C ideal binaryO2/N2 gas, first-order capacity relaxation, chosen attached fraction and uniform homothetic shell/sediment geometry. Drawing densities8/4.2/1g/mL. No vapour, dissolved-oxygen storage, evaporation, film inventory, finite wetting/transport, electrochemical fields, pH, heat, anaerobic paths, protective-layer kinetics or settling solver. Zero-volume schematic wick supplies wet reference availability. Hardware excluded consistently from mass. Ideal excluded controls do not establish perfect classroom drying/deoxygenation. Formula work is teacher extension; class placement editorial.
